Cut 11 of the `packages/objectql/src/engine.ts` split (#24586 ruling A, recorded in `6270097840`). The claim is `6426204595`. The whole "File-reference hydration" section moves unedited into a new module, `packages/objectql/src/engine-file-reference-hydration.ts`: `resolveFileReferences` (a read's file-field ids expanded to the `sys_file` read form), `callerMayReadSysFile` (#24335, the admission asked before the caller's own `sys_file` read), `serveRefusedFileHydration` (the refused arm), `servableFileRows` (the one servability rule both arms use) and `readParentDerivedFiles` (#22637, the field-owned verdict). The three module helpers only they use move with them: `isReadRefusal`, `toFileValue` and `PARENT_DERIVED_FILE_COLUMNS`. No behaviour changes. #25522 stays open for the later cuts.

Branch `claude/project-thread-umvn9e` (the card thread's harness-pinned branch), cut from `origin/main` at `bdfad1fc7`, which is cut 10's merge (#26308). Nothing was edited before that merge landed. `origin/main` (`a8e7393dd`) was merged in once before this PR opened; none of the commits it brought touch `packages/objectql/**`, `packages/core/src/security/**`, `content/docs/permissions/**` or `scripts/adr-anchors/**`.

## The shape

- The class keeps all five methods with name, modifiers (`private async`), signature, docblock and position. Each body is now one host literal of exactly the `FileReferenceHydrationHost` members it reads, plus a `.call`, marked `[#25522 cut 11]`, as cuts 8 and 10 did. Fields go as getters over a `readX` closure (`_registry`, `logger`, `_heldFileResolver`, `_fieldOwnedFileReadAuthorizer`); methods go as late-bound closures (`find`, `callerMayReadSysFile`, `serveRefusedFileHydration`, `servableFileRows`, `readParentDerivedFiles`, `resolveReadableIdsSecurity`), so a spy or double set on the engine is still the one a call reaches.
- **One named host.** `FileReferenceHydrationHost` types each member as the class member (`ObjectQL['find']` and so on); each function's `this` is the `Pick` of what it reads. The module imports the engine only as a type.
- **The helpers.** `isReadRefusal`, `toFileValue` and `PARENT_DERIVED_FILE_COLUMNS` move with their docblocks byte for byte and are not exported; every user of each was one of the five bodies. One copy, no re-derivation.
- **Imports.** The module imports `FILE_REFERENCE_TYPES`, `isFileIdToken`, `RAW_FILE_VALUES_CONTEXT_KEY` and the type `FileRefusedValue` (`@objectstack/spec/data`), `ExecutionContext` (type), `withoutOperationPrivateKeys` (`@objectstack/core`, with its three-line import comment, which names `readParentDerivedFiles`) and `isMissingTableError` (`@objectstack/metadata/errors`): the bindings `engine.ts` used. `engine.ts` drops `isFileIdToken`, `FileRefusedValue` and `withoutOperationPrivateKeys` (their last readers moved) and gains the module import with a two-line comment. `FILE_REFERENCE_TYPES`, `RAW_FILE_VALUES_CONTEXT_KEY` and `isMissingTableError` have readers left in `engine.ts` and stay imported there.
- The module header names what moved and why nothing in the section stays. It cites no ADR decision letter.

## Proof of move-only

A TypeScript-AST leaf-token compare (`pm-orders/server/evidence/25522/astcmp.mjs`, unchanged from cuts 9 and 10) of base `engine.ts` (`bdfad1fc7`) against the head module:

- All five bodies are **SAME** in parameters, return type, type parameters, body tokens and `async`, and every body line equals the base line less two leading spaces, comments included: `resolveFileReferences` 584 tokens / 150 lines, `callerMayReadSysFile` 81 / 8, `serveRefusedFileHydration` 239 / 30, `servableFileRows` 190 / 49, `readParentDerivedFiles` 427 / 51.
- The three helpers: the base text of each from its docblock to its end is a substring of the module, and `engine.ts` no longer declares them.
- Class: 318 members at both ends, in the same order. 313 are byte-identical, and the 5 stubs keep docblock, modifiers and signature byte-identical up to the body.
- Top level: 226 of 233 base statements are byte-identical in head. The other seven: the class; the three helpers, moved; the `@objectstack/spec/data` value import, less `isFileIdToken`; the `FileRefusedValue` type import, dropped; the `@objectstack/core` import, less `withoutOperationPrivateKeys` and its comment. `readStoredAutonumberCounter`, which followed the helpers, keeps its own text and its one leading blank line. Head adds the new module import with its comment.

## Readers of the moved lines

- **The row-serving door pin (migrated in this PR).** `packages/core/src/security/row-serving-door-exposure.pin.test.ts` (core's `repo` vitest project, CI's `Test Core`) classifies every file that calls `.canReadObject(`, and `callerMayReadSysFile` makes such a call. It gets a `not-a-door` row for `engine-file-reference-hydration.ts`, built from the method's own docblock: the ask only narrows what the caller's own `sys_file` read reads, and serves no row. The `engine.ts` row stays, since the ReadableIds composition still calls the admission there (2 sites). **Control:** without the row, the pin fails with exactly one unclassified file, the new module; with it, 6 of 6 files and 83 of 83 tests pass.
- **Every `repo` project** (`core`, `objectql`, `rest`, `runtime`, `spec`, `types`) was run after the build: all green (6, 1, 5, 3, 79 and 1 files). No other census keys a moved body: `second-object-read-exposure.pin.test.ts` keys callers of `referenceTargetOf`, which none of the five call; `operation-private-keys.pin.test.ts` keys declarations of the helper, not its callers.
- **The system-context census page.** `readParentDerivedFiles` writes `isSystem: true` into its sub-read's context; that is not a read site, so the page needs no row. `check-system-context-census` at base `a8e7393dd` and at head: 153 read sites across 82 files, 145 of 145 symbols cited, OK at both ends.
- **The federated injected-column readers table** keys no moved body (none calls `isFederatedObject`, `referenceTargetOf` or the tenant-field readers).
- **ADR anchors.** No `scripts/adr-anchors/` entry describes a moved body (the engine entry's one paragraph is the transaction seam), so no entry follows. Two body comments cite a decision letter (`ADR-0104 D3` in `readParentDerivedFiles`, `ADR-0110 D3` in `resolveFileReferences`' `catch`) and leave the anchored `engine.ts` with their bodies, so the decision-letter count drops by two. `check-adr-anchors` at base `a8e7393dd` (clean detached worktree): 90 anchored files, **1,880** decision-letter citations, 59,270 resolving citations; at head: 90, **1,878**, 59,270. The method docblocks that cite ADR-0104 D3 stay on the class.
- No `objectql/src/engine.ts#NAME` pointer under `packages/spec/**`, `docs/adr/**`, `docs/qa/**` or `content/**` names any of the five or the helpers. Prose that names `resolveFileReferences` (`driver-sql`'s `sql-driver.ts`, the hydration tests, `service-storage`'s agreement test, `check-durability-degradation-log-level.mjs` header comments, CHANGELOGs) still resolves, because the method stays on the class. No gate baseline keys a moved body (`durability-read-invention.baseline.json` does not; the moved bodies hold no `query-options/no-any-erasure` site, and `query-options-erasure-baseline.json` keeps `engine.ts` at 8).

## Acceptance notes

- Serial check, re-read before `pr_create` (29 open PRs): one opened after this cut started touches `engine.ts`. #26337 (draft, ADR-0142 phase 2, opened 21:46Z) edits it in nine hunks: an import near line 241, three type and constant declarations, and the `insert` / `update` bodies (from base line 15727 on). None is in the moved section (base lines 13473 to 13916) or on the import lines this cut edits, and `git merge-tree --write-tree` of this head with its head `578e7a417` merges cleanly (exit 0; its own generated `packages/spec` files are regenerated by their merge driver, as on any merge). Under the card's rule 4 whichever lands second merges `main`. Otherwise #26138 edits `validation/rule-validator.test.ts` only and #25640 the objectql `CHANGELOG.md` and `package.json` only; no open PR touches the row-serving pin, `system-context.mdx` or `scripts/adr-anchors/`.
- One receiver note, not a change in what runs: `servableFileRows` calls `this._heldFileResolver(tombstoned)`. In the class the call's receiver was the engine; in the module it is the host, whose getter returns the same function. Both registrations (`service-storage`'s plugin and the parent-derived test) pass arrow functions, and `HeldFileResolver` declares no `this`, so nothing reads the receiver. `readParentDerivedFiles` copies its authorizer into a local before calling it, so that call has no receiver at either end.
- Next cut from this screen: Driver options and engine posture (about -110 to -120; `engineLayer0Verdict` moves only with `driverWriteTarget`, so `accessibleOrganizationsOf` stays module-local; 84 of 146 body lines are recent). Migration flags still needs a setter ruling.
